body.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production body-only animation sprite sheet for the established pixel RPG Battle of Gods.
Reference image 1 is King's approved identity and body proportions. Reference image 2 shows the old body-only pose-sheet format, not the motions to repeat.
Create a NEW Twinsteel dual-sword combo, FIVE horizontal rows of EIGHT fully separated whole-body cels (40 figures), all using exactly the same small chibi King: spiky charcoal hair, crimson neck scarf trailing left, dark blue charcoal short tunic, pale silver shoulder and hem details, brown CLOSED gloves, brown boots. Preserve the reference face, scarf socket, short torso/legs, thin dark readable outlines. No new armor or hair colors. Nearest pixel-art clusters, no painting gradients.
All ordinary attacks face RIGHT, 3/4 side RPG camera. The spin row turns the WHOLE body through front, left, back and right. Same head/limb scale through turns. Bodies only: no swords, no sword handles, no VFX. Each arm and closed fist must be clearly visible and attached, separated from the torso by its dark outline, with elbows connected. Fists represent a short sword in EACH hand. Their axes should follow the described cuts.
Eight cels within each row: 1 ready/load, 2 loading torso twist, 3 last preparation, 4 decisive first contact pose, 5 fastest sweep pass, 6 followthrough, 7 settle/reload, 8 ready for next cut. Short sharp ACTIVE and expressive torso/arms, no punching thrust motions.
ROW1: near-hand diagonal descending cut from high left to forward low right; other fist carries its blade back beside hip. Hips twist and knee braces. Not a thrust.
ROW2: far-hand rising RETURN CUT from low-forward right toward high-forward right with torso unwind; near fist retracts toward hip. Maintain target on RIGHT; no turning the character backwards.
ROW3: two separate fists cross at chest in preparation, then both rise and OPEN outward in a bold forward rising crosscut; both forearms fully connected, no merged gloves.
ROW4: compact hopping full-body spin: right load, front quarter, front, left, back-left, back, back-right, land facing right. Feet tuck a little only; no giant body or oversized head. Both fists extend a little to carry two blades around.
ROW5: small springing crossing finisher: crouch/load, fists lift together, short rise, decisive two-armed forward crossing downward cut, both blades' wrists pass on different levels, body braces landing, settle, ready. No giant jump, no uppercut punch.
Keep the whole boot sole inside each cell, and keep grounded cels on one equal baseline. Leave at least 25% transparent gutters and uniform centers, no cel touches its neighbor, no neighboring fragments. No weapons/text/guide dots/grid lines/shadows/backdrops. Transparent background. Exactly five rows by eight columns.

slash.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent production slash-animation sprite sheet for Battle of Gods Twinsteel dual swords.
Reference is the APPROVED Greatsword V2 white/silver/dark-slate raster ribbon vocabulary. Generate NEW dual-sword effects in that same palette, crisp dark exterior edge, white core and stepped silver trailing facets. Give dual swords lighter clean sharp ribbons with twin cutting tracks. No blue/teal/yellow/gold glow. No blurred vector curves, no circles drawn with lines, no lightning, no character, no weapons, no text.
Exactly FIVE ROWS, FOUR CELS in each row; LARGE transparent gutters, every effect and spark wholly inside its own cel. Equal frame scale within a row. Each row is consecutive ignition/contact/sweep/dissipation, the last frame SMALL FADING fragments rather than a new giant attack.
ROW1: a forward-opening descending CRESCENT from upper-left to lower-right, thick decisive single white leading edge with a lighter secondary blade echo. Full strong forward arc, not a narrow thrust.
ROW2: an upward returning forward crescent from lower-left to upper-right, reverse chronological sweep. Same thickness and scale as row1.
ROW3: TWO rising diagonal ribbons that separate/open from crossed origin into wide forward forked crosscut. Both curved cutting ribbons stay distinct.
ROW4: two broad horizontal elliptical orbit ribbons for hopping spin, overlapping silver blade echoes in a full circle with hollow center. Ground-perspective ellipse, not round flat UI.
ROW5: forceful crossing diagonal crescents creating a broad sharp forward X, with short falling silver chips after impact. Two separate cuts, not a starburst magic symbol.
The leading core has 3/4 bright white and small slate silver edge; readable at small game scale. Step edges deliberately like pixel RPG sprites. Transparent background. Keep at least 15% clear margins on every side of every cel, no effect touches another, no source fragment crosses a gutter.
